help.title: About this screen
welcome.title: Welcome to Gaffer's Notebook
welcome.game: You are the coach in the dugout. Design tactics, watch your team play, take on challenges and play a league season. Your decisions shape the match.
welcome.keys:
Space - pause · B - substitutions and tactics · Esc - settings and home
F11 - fullscreen · F1 - help · F9 - feedback
welcome.early: Open beta candidate. Matches usually take 4–5 minutes, plus pauses. AI and balance are still being tested. Report problems through Feedback (F9).
onboarding.title: Your first steps
onboarding.step.substitution: 2. Make a substitution in a match (B)
onboarding.step.tactic: 3. Create and save your own tactic
onboarding.step.meter: 4. Compare two tactics in the meter
help.menu.1: You are the coach: your tactics guide the players.
help.menu.2: Kick off plays a full match in about 4–5 real minutes. Challenges offer specific goals; Play live lets you coach each match.
help.menu.3: The checklist records five things to try. Go there opens the relevant screen.
help.menu.4: Esc opens all settings, including language, match length, display and feedback.
help.challenges.1: Challenges give your tactic a concrete goal over several matches.
help.challenges.2: Try Score against the block with Possession 4-2-3-1. Read the goals first.
help.challenges.3: Choose your tactic and team level, then Play live. B opens substitutions during the match.
help.challenges.4: Finish a match and continue to see your progress. Simulate all runs the whole challenge for you. Cancel stops a simulation or opponent preparation without saving a result.
help.editor.1: The Tactic maker lets you design how your team plays.
help.editor.2: Open a tactic or choose New and a formation. Select a phase above the pitch.
help.editor.3: Drag a player or select one to change a role or instruction. Start with one small change.
help.editor.4: Enter a new filename and Save. Compare it with the original in the meter. Open → Export file shares a JSON file with friends; Open → Import file opens theirs. Save after importing to keep your own copy.
help.meter.1: The Tactic meter compares two tactics over repeated matches, swapping home and away.
help.meter.2: Choose your saved tactic as A and the original as B, then Compare. Wait for the report.
help.meter.3: Read wins, draws and losses, then the differences and heatmaps to see what changed.
help.meter.4: The meter starts a comparison when opened. Cancel stops it; then choose tactics and Compare to restart. Results describe these matches; they are no guarantee.
help.season.1: League is a season with a table, fixtures and promotion or relegation.
help.season.2: Choose a tactic for the next match, then play live or simulate a round.
help.season.3: In a live match, B opens substitutions and Space pauses. Finish the match and return here.
help.season.4: Read the table and schedule after the round. Your career is saved automatically.
help.squad.1: Squad shows your players and how well they understand the chosen tactic.
help.squad.2: Choose a team level and tactic to inspect the players and reserves.
help.squad.3: Look at the demands and familiarity before training a concept.
help.squad.4: Learning is limited per period. Try a simpler tactic if the demands are too high.
season.familiarity_warning: Your tactic is too demanding for your squad. Choose a simpler tactic or train.
feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.intro: Tell the maker what happened or what you think. A zip file is saved on your desktop; nothing is sent. You can open the zip and check it before you send it yourself.
feedback.contents: It contains a screenshot of this window, the game log, version and system type (Windows, processor, memory), your progress files and your note.
feedback.note_placeholder: What happened, or what did you expect?
feedback.saved_hint: Nothing has been sent. Send this file to the maker yourself.
feedback.failed: The feedback file could not be saved: {0}
feedback.error_body: The game ran into an unexpected problem. You can usually keep playing. A feedback file helps the maker to fix it; nothing is sent automatically.
match.speed.title: MATCH PACE
match.speed.help: About 4–5 minutes at the standard pace; pauses add time. B pauses at the next break for coaching. The full 90 minutes are simulated.
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Game, display and navigation in one place. The match pauses while this page is open.
settings.pace_hint: All 90 football minutes are simulated. Pauses add time; the chosen pace also applies to your current match.
settings.language_hint: Language changes take effect when you return to the home screen. On the home screen, close Settings to apply them.
settings.display_hint: You can resize the game window by dragging its edge. F11 also toggles fullscreen.
settings.controls: Esc: settings / back. Space: pause match. B: coaching at the next break. End: calculate the remaining match. F1: screen help. F9: feedback.
settings.feedback_hint: Feedback creates a local package with your note, screenshot, logs and progress. Nothing is sent automatically.
settings.save_failed: Active for this session, but saving failed. Check write access to your progress folder.
settings.leave_warning: Return home? The current match or challenge will stop. Results that have not been saved will be lost.
settings.quit_warning: Quit the game? The current match or calculation will stop. Saved progress will remain.
help.match.1: Your tactics guide the players. Standard matches take about 4–5 real minutes; pauses add time.
help.match.2: Space pauses immediately. B opens coaching and substitutions at the next break in play.
help.match.3: Esc opens Settings without leaving your match. Change match length, display or popup preferences there.
help.match.4: End calculates the remaining match. The end card shows the result, statistics and pitch coverage.
settings.audio_hint: All music and sound effects are generated for this game. Changes apply at once.
